evidence: Four lithium based compounds were used, namely, LiTMSO (Sigma Aldrich, 97%), lithium benzoate (Sigma Aldrich, 99%), lithium acetate dihydrate (Sigma Aldrich, 99.999%), and lithium triﬂuoroacetate (Sigma Aldrich, 95%). Trimethyl aluminum (TMA, Witco GmbH, 98%) was kept in a metal bubbler at room temperature. Ozone was generated by feeding O2 (AGA 99.999%) into an ozone generator (InUSA AC series) generating O3 at a concentration of ca. 200 g (N m3)/C0 1 at a flow of ca. 500 cm3 min/C0 1. Deionized H2O was contained in a glass bubbler at room temperature, and CO2 (95%, AGA) was also used as reactant. N2(g) was used as pulse and purge gas, generated by a Schmidelin-Sirocco 5 (99.999% purity with respect to N2 þ Ar).
